claim: A single omniseek_search call with the frozen need as the query returns text containing the claim key.
frozen_need: I moved to Canada on a foreign licence, drove on it for about a year in one province, then relocated to another province before ever converting it. I can't work out whose rules now apply: whether the driving experience I can document from my home country still counts toward skipping the graduated stages in the new province, whether that clock restarted when I moved, and what proof the new province will accept when my home authority won't issue anything in English or French.

args.query: I moved to Canada on a foreign licence, drove on it for about a year in one province, then relocated to another province before ever converting it. I can't work out whose rules now apply: whether the driving experience I can document from my home country still counts toward skipping the graduated stages in the new province, whether that clock restarted when I moved, and what proof the new province will accept when my home authority won't issue anything in English or French.

ground_truth.value: You can combine documents from multiple jurisdictions to reach the two-year requirement.

accepted_forms: 你可以合并来自多个辖区的文件，以满足两年的要求。

settles: BC lets an applicant combine documents from multiple jurisdictions to reach the two-year experience requirement, which supports a GLP exemption; non-English documents need an ICBC-approved translation with originals or issuer-certified copies
leaves_open: whether the year driven on a foreign licence in the previous province counts toward the two years
the effect of never converting in the previous province
how provinces other than BC would treat the same history
